notes.title: Furr Grinder 185 Upgrade Bug Fix!
notes.notes:
YOU WILL NEED TO DELETE SAVED GAME DATA ON MAIN MENU FOR THIS UPDATE TO TAKE EFFECT!
Furr Grinder 185 Upgrade Bug Fix:
Thanks to a review I tested the game extensively over the past 48 hours, and found that the grinder does indeed break at exactly 185 upgrades. Now at upgrade 185 the cost will be 5 million per upgrade after. This "fixes" the bug by at least giving the player a way to continue upgrading past 185!!!
